name: 2005 World Championships Deck: King of the West

releases.name: 2005 World Championships Deck: King of the West

description.text:
A top-four deck of the Junior division at the 2005 World Championships: a Ludicolo deck with Magcargo, whose Smooth Over sets up the next draw, Ludicolo's own drawing power, and Rhydon. The 2005 World Championships were held at the Town and Country Resort and Convention Center in San Diego, California, from 19 to 21 August 2005.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2005 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
